_comment: Single source of truth for tenant-sourcing decisions. The discovery agent (discovery/*) and, where relevant, /add-tenant read THIS file at run time. NO sourcing rule is hardcoded in code. Change a rule here, re-run discovery, and a disposition changes with no code edit (that is the acceptance test). The reason this exists at all: a rule copied into two places drifts (see the four definitions of 'new'). When a decision like 'no more grocery' is made, it is one line here and every consumer picks it up. Field contract for the segment/footprint/size vocabularies is documented in discovery/classify.py; the disposition machinery reads exclusions -> deprioritized -> segments -> thresholds/gates -> carve_outs.

segments._note: Stage 1 axis 1. A candidate whose segment is in 'frontline' proceeds; one in 'non_frontline' is ruled out before any network call (a tech company cannot supply no-experience frontline roles regardless of size). A segment in neither list and not covered by deprioritized/exclusions is UNKNOWN -> needs_review, never estimated.

footprint._note: Stage 1 axis 2, HEAVIEST prioritization weight. Market is a config parameter, so a national employer's adapter serves every future market from one build. national outranks regional outranks local. tier_weight is the base tier a footprint earns before size/unknown adjustments.

size._note: Stage 1 axis 3, volume proxy, ONLY matters inside a correct segment. A large in-market presence can hold a tier; small drops one within tier. enterprise/large hold, mid neutral, small demotes.

gates._note: Role-level requirement gate, applied when sampling descriptions in Stage 2. A role hitting any 'fail' clause fails the gate; a role hitting any 'pass' clause passes. Carve-outs below override title-based reflexes. IMPORTANT: this gate scores ROLES, not the candidate. A low sampled-applicable count is needs_review, never a reject (density never rejects at Stage 2).
fail: licence or certification the candidate must already hold

carve_outs.rule: management and sales training programs are not excluded
carve_outs.basis: title does not decide inclusion, the requirement gate does

carve_outs.rule: internships and long-runway apprenticeships remain excluded
